sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Drawer is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Drawers are loot containers that are interacted with when searching filing cabinets. Most filing cabinets have 4 drawers, each of which can be searched individually. Each drawer is a 2x2 grid.
